Who We Are
Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, our search engine, and the latest — Privacy Pro. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work — you've come to the right place!

Your Team and Role
Working on the Web Dependability Engineering team, you'll make sure websites just work in DuckDuckGo's browsers across Mac, Windows, iOS, and Android, helping ensure our users have the best-possible experience browsing with DuckDuckGo. Recent projects include:
• 
Reverse-engineering how sites detect our privacy protections and building countermeasures that keep pages working
• 
Shimming browser APIs so sites work seamlessly across different browser engines and system webviews
• 
Building LLM agent pipelines that automatically reproduce and triage reported site breakage
 
As a Senior Web Compatibility Engineer, you'll be our resident expert on why websites break and how to fix them: owning the webcompat side of our triage process, debugging gnarly issues in code you don't control, distinguishing site bugs from browser bugs from privacy protection-induced breakage, leading the charge when a top site breaks and becomes an incident, shipping durable fixes across every platform, and work on related projects that prevent user churn and keep users coming back to DuckDuckGo.

About You
• 
7+ years of experience building and debugging complex web applications with vanilla JavaScript.
• 
Detailed knowledge of web standards, web components, and browser APIs. Any additional experience with our stack is a bonus: Swift/Kotlin/C#/C++/Python.
• 
Advanced ability to reverse-engineer obfuscated third-party code and reduce issues to minimal test cases.
• 
Passion for hunting elusive bugs and tracing them to their root cause.
• 
Interest in automating repetitive work and building agentic tooling that multiplies the team's impact.
• 
Experience triaging issues, leading incident response, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• 
Experience shipping code beyond the web, like native or desktop clients.
• 
Ability to lead complex, ambiguous projects with little to no oversight.

Compensation
$178,500 USD annually and stock options. Compensation is identical within professional levels, regardless of geographic location or team. Compensation for each professional level is transparent across the organization. 
Eligibility for company-sponsored health benefits is limited to team members based in the United States. This program does not extend to team members located in other countries, such as Canada or the UK.
Our Team Member Support Guide explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.

Hiring Process
Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.

We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to 

Please note that:
• 
You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing
• 
Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.
• 
While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.
• 
A successful candidate must pass a background check as a condition of joining the team.
• 
By applying for this role, you confirm that all information submitted is accurate and complete. You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.

Disclosure Statement: Use of AI in Hiring Process
As part of our commitment to enhancing our recruitment process, we utilize artificial intelligence (AI) technology to assist in reviewing and summarizing job applications and test projects, including those tools integrated into our recruitment vendor platforms. We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

Key Principles:
• 
Data Privacy: All information provided in your application will be handled in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Policy. We ensure that your personal information is protected and used solely for recruitment purposes.

Human Oversight and Accountability: The AI technology is designed to support our hiring team by providing insights and summaries of applications and evaluations of test projects against scoring rubrics. All final evaluations and hiring decisions, however, will be made by our hiring team, who will consider the AI's input alongside other factors.
• 
Transparency: We believe in transparency regarding our hiring practices. If you have any questions about how AI is used in our recruitment process, please feel free to reach out to us.

Talent Partner, G&A

Location: Bengaluru, India — Hybrid Department: People — Talent Acquisition

 

About the Role

You'll lead hiring for Rubrik's G&A organization in India, and be the talent voice in the room when leaders decide how those teams get built. This is a senior individual-contributor seat: you'll run the hardest G&A searches yourself — Finance, Legal, People, IT, Business Operations — while advising VPs on leveling, location, and org shape, and setting the standard the wider Talent Partner team follows.

About the Team

Rubrik's India Talent Acquisition team hires across Engineering, Go-to-Market, and G&A from our Bengaluru site, one of the company's fastest-growing locations. You'll be among the most senior recruiters here, partnering with functional leaders and their global counterparts, and looked to by peers on how full life-cycle recruiting should be done.

What You'll Do

  • Lead full life-cycle recruitment for Rubrik's most complex and senior G&A searches in India — leadership hires and scarce specialist roles alike.
  • Advise Senior Manager and above stakeholders on hiring strategy, driving leveling decisions, team composition, and location choices rather than reacting to them.
  • Design and run sourcing strategies across channels and modalities without direction, using competitive intelligence to move passive talent who weren't looking.
  • Make diverse pipelines structural to every search: build them into intake, involve interview panels in sourcing, and evidence the outcome req by req.
  • Bring internal talent and mobility into the conversation with your business partners, treating early-career and internal-promotion paths as real options.
  • Lead a Talent Acquisition initiative that outlasts a single req — candidate experience, interviewer calibration, reporting, or process improvement — and pull the team into it.
  • Set the bar on tools and process: model best practice in the ATS, teach peers, and challenge how we work when there's a better way.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years of full life-cycle recruiting, with several years owning senior and leadership hiring for G&A or corporate functions.
  • A record of independently running complex searches to close across more than one function or business unit.
  • Credibility with Senior stakeholders — evidence that your talent recommendations changed a hiring decision, a level, or an org design.
  • Fluency with market and competitive intelligence data, and the judgment to forecast a search with reliable accuracy.
  • Advanced command of an ATS and sourcing stack, at the level where peers come to you for guidance.
  • Persuasive communication under pressure: you can close a senior candidate and reframe a panel's view of a profile in the same week.
  • Deep knowledge of the Indian talent market across cities and functions.

Bonus Points

  • Building or scaling G&A hiring at a public or recently public technology company.
  • Leading a cross-functional TA initiative with measurable results.
  • Partnering with HR and Finance on headcount and location planning.

 

You'll embody Rubrik's RIVET values — Relentlessness, Integrity, Velocity, Excellence, and Transparency — in how you collaborate, make decisions, and show up for Stakeholders and teammates.

Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

Who We Are
Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.
Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.
The Opportunity
Atlan is building the context layer for the AI era, the control plane that makes enterprise data usable, governed, extensible, and AI-ready.
We're looking for an Engineering Manager to join one of our core platform teams. This is not a coordination role. We need an engineer-first, hands-on platform leader who has built and owned foundational systems at scale, whether that's distributed platform primitives and ingestion infrastructure, or data quality systems and AI-native product surfaces that sit on top of them.

What will you do? 🤔
Build the AI-ready context foundation
Lead the engineering charter to design and evolve an AI-ready context store across structured, unstructured, vector, and graph systems. This platform powers apps, agents, and enterprise workflows on top of trusted data.
Own core platform primitives
Drive end-to-end delivery of complex platform capabilities, including:
• 
High-scale ingestion and validation frameworks
• 
Contract-driven routing, storage, and serving layers
• 
Multi-tenant isolation and noisy-neighbor resilience
• 
Search APIs with sub-second P95 response times
• 
Systems operating at 99.99% availability
You’ll simplify ambiguous problems, define clear technical direction, and ensure teams ship durable, high-leverage infrastructure.
Lead from the front
Engage deeply in architecture and systems design. Guide distributed systems tradeoffs, review RFCs, unblock critical issues, and participate meaningfully in technical decisions. This role requires technical depth, not just coordination.
Scale teams and operational excellence
Build and mentor high-performing engineers. Define engineering metrics, on-call practices, SLO discipline, and incident processes. Strengthen the operational engine behind a platform serving 100K+ users and billions of assets.
 
What makes you a great match for us? 😍
Experience building data or platform primitives at scale
You’ve built or owned foundational systems such as:
• 
Data ingestion frameworks or lakehouse foundations
• 
Metadata, governance, or catalog platforms
• 
Multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure and tenant isolation mechanisms
• 
Search, storage, or distributed serving layers
• 
Data quality, validation, or contract enforcement systems
We’re particularly excited about leaders who have operated in data platform environments but equally value those who have built core platforms and shared infrastructure powering enterprise SaaS systems.
Platform leadership experience
You’ve led and scaled engineering teams (including managing managers), ideally within platform, infrastructure, or data-heavy SaaS organizations.
Strong distributed systems and reliability depth
You bring credibility in distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and operating high-availability platforms with strict SLOs.
Builder mindset with high agency
You thrive in ambiguity, move fast with ownership, and build foundational systems from first principles. You’re comfortable operating in evolving environments and shaping direction, not just executing on defined scope.
AI-native curiosity
You actively explore AI-assisted development workflows and think critically about how agentic systems will reshape developer productivity and platform design. You don’t need to be an AI/ML expert, but you should be excited to build in this shift.
Systems thinker and people-first leader
You connect technical decisions to product strategy and org design, while prioritizing clarity, trust, and team growth.
 
Why this role is different
This is foundational work in building a world class data platform, not feature delivery.
You’ll help define how enterprise data becomes the context layer for AI systems. High leverage. Deep technical ownership. Real scale.

Why Atlan?
Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:
• 
Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.
• 
AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.
• 
Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.
• 
Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.
• 
Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.
• 
Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us
Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”
We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
